convention: For one evaluation case e, times are in seconds and the case subscript is omitted from within-case chunk symbols (i, t_i, X_i, z_i), transcripts (Y) and prompts (Q); e always identifies a question, while m always identifies a model.

symbols.name: Number of distinct questions
symbols.definition: N=105 for the main evaluation; alternative phrasings and reruns do not create extra cases.

symbols.name: Evaluation case index
symbols.definition: e is an integer from 1 to N; one case is one question, its earlier conversation audio, its recorded request and its checked reference answer, not one meeting (example: e=17 is the seventeenth question).

symbols.name: Model identity
symbols.definition: m identifies a checkpoint and its inference mode from the selected model list (example: DuplexOmni S1 or Qwen3-30B Instruct); it is not an index for meetings.

symbols.name: Frozen model weights
symbols.definition: Weights of model m; record the checkpoint revision, precision, mode and decoding settings alongside every run.

symbols.name: Conditional output distribution
symbols.definition: The distribution used to generate an output with model m given the inputs after the conditioning bar; sampling is denoted by the tilde symbol in the update equation.

symbols.name: ASR/diarization pipeline choice
symbols.definition: v is D1 (Parakeet plus Nemotron diarization) or D2 (WhisperX plus pyannote); each produces its own words and speaker labels.

symbols.name: Thinking-goal choice
symbols.definition: g is an integer from 0 to 4, selecting Q0 summary, Q1 facts/events, Q2 people/tasks, Q3 checks/implications or Q4 combined goals.

symbols.name: Goal selected on development meetings
symbols.definition: The selected g for a given model and input type; freeze it before the final 105-question evaluation.

symbols.name: Elapsed input time
symbols.definition: Time in seconds from the start of the meeting audio supplied to this case; the injected request follows the available original conversation and no resumed future speech is included.

symbols.name: Request onset
symbols.definition: Time in seconds when the inserted user request begins for case e; earlier reasoning must use only audio/transcripts available before this time.

symbols.name: Request end
symbols.definition: Time in seconds when the inserted user request ends; final answer inputs include the whole request through this time.

symbols.name: Audio waveform and audio history
symbols.definition: A_e(t) is the input waveform at time t; A_{e,≤t} is all input audio through t, including the inserted request when t reaches its end.

symbols.name: Number of S1 input frames
symbols.definition: Number of native frames for model m covering case e through the complete request; any required trailing silence is recorded separately.

symbols.name: Native S1 frame index
symbols.definition: j is an integer from 1 to J_{m,e}; frames are the small audio blocks accepted by model m, whose duration is model-specific (480 ms for the current DuplexOmni caller).

symbols.name: Native S1 audio frame
symbols.definition: The jth native audio frame for model m within the current case e; x_{1:J_{m,e}} means the full ordered frame sequence through request end.

symbols.name: Number of earlier thinking chunks
symbols.definition: Number of complete larger chunks available before S_e for case e; low-speech chunks are kept in history even when no model call is made.

symbols.name: Larger thinking-chunk index
symbols.definition: i is an integer from 1 to K_e; it counts the shared 10–40 second chunks, not native S1 frames or generated tokens.

symbols.name: Thinking-chunk end time
symbols.definition: End of chunk i in seconds, with t_0=0; a reusable earlier result must finish its input chunk before S_e.

symbols.name: Audio in thinking chunk i
symbols.definition: The samples after t_{i-1} through t_i; chunks regroup the same speech supplied to S1 without dropping or duplicating samples.

symbols.name: Recorded user request
symbols.definition: The inserted spoken question for case e, beginning with the Assistant wake word; voice-enrollment clips are excluded from the model history.

symbols.name: Exact text of the user request
symbols.definition: The text matching the chosen recorded question; append it to manual transcript history because the inserted request is absent from the original meeting transcript.

symbols.name: Ground-truth transcript through time t
symbols.definition: Manual words, speaker labels and timestamps already available by t for this case; no future words from an unfinished utterance are included.

symbols.name: Generated transcript through time t
symbols.definition: Words, speaker labels and times from pipeline v using only the available audio; preserve released versions and do not apply future corrections early.

symbols.name: Complete request-time input history
symbols.definition: The declared input for the condition: Y through T_e, generated Y through T_e or audio A through T_e; include the full spoken/text request.

symbols.name: Input history through chunk i
symbols.definition: The same input type as D_e, limited to t_i; this history contains no later user request.

symbols.name: Thinking instructions
symbols.definition: Q^(g) is the selected instruction/goal family; Q_{≤i}^(g) is the sequence of instructions issued through chunk i, based only on earlier discussion.

symbols.name: Common answer-format instruction
symbols.definition: The same final-answer instruction is used in each paired condition and omitted from the probability formulas for readability.

symbols.name: Earlier native reasoning text
symbols.definition: Reasoning text generated for chunk i when the model exposes a native thinking channel; absent channels remain N/A.

symbols.name: Saved notes
symbols.definition: The text saved after chunk i, such as facts, task owners, changed decisions or checked implications with source references; these notes are not spoken to participants.

symbols.name: Result of an earlier thinking call
symbols.definition: The optional native reasoning text and saved notes generated for chunk i; z_i is a result, whereas i is only an index.

symbols.name: Results before chunk i
symbols.definition: The ordered earlier results supplied to the next thinking call; record exactly which results survive any capacity fallback.

symbols.name: Earlier results available for the request
symbols.definition: The retained results generated from chunks ending before S_e; never include a result that used the current question.

symbols.name: Native thinking for the actual request
symbols.definition: New native reasoning text generated after receiving the request, including any additional request-conditioned reasoning calls; earlier reasoning read again is input, not new thinking.

symbols.name: Final answer text
symbols.definition: The text answer returned for case e, kept separately from thinking text and control messages.

symbols.name: Output speech waveform
symbols.definition: The actual model speech played/saved for the response, excluding discarded synthesis and input speech.

symbols.name: Native S1 response
symbols.definition: The response returned by S1; depending on the system it contains output speech o_e and optional native text r_e or control fields.

symbols.name: Transcript of generated answer speech
symbols.definition: Independent ASR applied to o_e for scoring; listen directly when words, names or numbers are disputed.

symbols.name: Encoded input audio
symbols.definition: Model m’s audio representation for frame j, which may be continuous embeddings or discrete audio tokens; it is not a text thinking token.

symbols.name: Output audio codes
symbols.definition: The model-specific acoustic codes used to synthesize case e’s response; report them separately from text tokens.

symbols.name: Model m’s text tokenization
symbols.definition: Use native generated token IDs where available; counts recovered by retokenizing text must be marked approximate. Vertical bars around a token sequence mean its number of tokens.

symbols.name: Request-time native thinking tokens
symbols.definition: Number of new tokens in h_e; excludes earlier reasoning and answer text, with N/A for an absent channel and unavailable for an unexposed one.

symbols.name: Request-time answer tokens
symbols.definition: Number of newly generated final-answer text tokens in r_e.

symbols.name: Request-time control tokens
symbols.definition: Number of newly generated text control/protocol tokens, listed separately from answer and thinking tokens.

symbols.name: Amortized-thinking output tokens
symbols.definition: Total text tokens generated by earlier calls: optional native reasoning and saved notes, including unhelpful updates; earlier input/prefill is counted separately.

symbols.name: All request-time text output tokens
symbols.definition: Recorded total of new request-time thinking, answer, helper and text control tokens; report directly if native thinking is unexposed.

symbols.name: Request-time input tokens
symbols.definition: All text input tokens processed for the request, including earlier reasoning and notes read again; report audio positions separately.

symbols.name: Other request-time generated text
symbols.definition: Output from any declared request-time helper; the main plan uses deterministic history selection, so no helper is assumed.

symbols.name: Verified reference answer
symbols.definition: Checked answer based only on evidence available before this request; never an input to the evaluated system.

symbols.name: Required answer facts
symbols.definition: The source-supported facts, people, quantities and decision status needed for correctness; also record allowed alternatives and uncertainty.

symbols.name: Complete-answer score
symbols.definition: a_e=1 for a complete source-supported answer without a material unsupported claim; otherwise 0, including silence, missing output and capacity failure. Scoring must be finished before a final accuracy is reported.

symbols.name: Final accuracy over all 105 cases
symbols.definition: The sum of complete-answer scores divided by 105; partial-run accuracy is labeled provisional and uses its own displayed reviewed-case denominator.

symbols.name: Usable model input budget
symbols.definition: The model-specific number of input positions available after reserving output space; record text/audio position counts and memory constraints.

symbols.name: History-selection rule
symbols.definition: A fixed rule selecting history and earlier results within budget B using only available inputs; never use reference facts, future speech or scoring labels.

symbols.name: History and earlier results retained after selection
symbols.definition: The selected inputs when full history does not fit; keep this condition distinct from full-history and model-native rolling context.

compatibility: Version 2 updates the unrun plan and empty templates only; recorded prompts, model outputs and historical data are unchanged.
